elements.element: Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties.
elements.evidence: Section 13.5 expressly requires the Customer-payable Termination for Convenience Fee and deems it liquidated damages.

elements.element: Any Customer-payable liquidated amount is only an early-termination fee.
elements.evidence: Sections 11.1 and 11.2(A) use the single Termination for Convenience Fee for the covered early-termination scenarios, and Section 13.5 identifies that fee as the sole liquidated amount.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
elements.evidence: Section 11.1 fixes the fee at three times the average monthly Fees payable during the three months before termination.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 13.5 expressly states: “The Termination for Convenience Fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer under this Agreement.”
